The five complete N_r(s) histograms follow direct coordinate vanishing tests and Gaussian-binomial totals. An independently organized projective rank-incidence enumeration of all 1,210 vector three-spaces reproduces the dual six-point plane sections, the exact six extremal sets and their 15 pairwise overlap counts. For any ternary 2-space the four projective words count each occupied coordinate exactly three times; 3|Supp(U)| >= 4*14 gives d2>=19, realized by six enumerated spaces each of weights (14,14,14,15). The complete executable verify.py was run from its actual package path and printed VERIFY_OK; no infinite assertion or floating error is involved.

value.rationale: The ordinary distance 14 in a new explicit LCD construction does not determine higher generalized weights, their multiplicities or the geometry of all smallest-support subspaces. Here the complete N_r(s) classification reveals the natural exact second-weight cutoff d2=19, its six realizing 2-spaces, explicit six-coordinate complements, their pair-incidence pattern and unique coordinate in five extremal sections; these are invariant support-geometry data relevant to the natural higher-dimensional erasure/shortening behavior of the code. The object and invariant are established by the primary construction and contemporary matroid-weight-spectrum theory, so this is a motivated full finite census rather than an arbitrary table slice, textbook renaming, or tiny parameter gain. No universal extension or application theorem is claimed.
